text: Emmanuelle Roni Cohen Skaly actually it is possible to leave and enter back in while in the process. you need to ask from PIBA for multi entry visa. We got that when they changed my husband’s b2 visa to b1 visa. There is a fee for b1 visa and separate fee for the entry visa but wroth it if you need to travel. We also started the process when my husband was on a tourist visa.
